symbols.read: Bias stays bullish and is confirmed, not revised: price holds at 366.97 above the 348.36 pivot with the combined 1D+1H read still BUY and the 1H trend up, so the prior call's structure is intact. The only shifts are mechanical — the upper pivot ticked up from 348.15 to 348.36, the target moved from 370.49 to 370.91, and the stop sits at 346.54 — leaving price roughly 18 points above entry and about 4 points shy of the target. With no open FVGs, upside remains thin into 370.91; a close above it extends the move, while a drop back below 348.36 revives the bearish case toward 325.81. Regime is still NEUTRAL, so no chase here — 370.91 is the next test and 346.54 the invalidation.

Bias stays bearish and the setup is unchanged from the prior read: price is flat at 248.25, still capped by the two overhead bear FVGs at 248.82–248.90 and 251.05–251.58, with the 1H trend down and the combined signal still SELL. The only revision is mechanical — the stop has widened from 246.66 to 246.86 — while entry at 244.72 and target 224.11 hold, keeping the watching short roughly 3.5 points from trigger. Nothing has broken: no pivot break, no gap fill, no trend flip, so the prior bearish read is confirmed rather than revised. Plan unchanged: bearish below 265.34, a break of 244.72 triggers the short, and a push back above 265.34 invalidates it.

AVGO remains a watching sell with the combined stance still HOLD, but the setup has shifted: price at 339.00 now sits above the 338.03 top of the bearish FVG rather than inside it, and the lower pivot has moved down to 321.02, so the entry, stop (324.57) and target (261.20) have all reset lower. The 1H trend stays up against a bearish 1D, the same conflict as before, and the last 1H bar's -0.53% slip keeps sellers active without confirming a rejection. Bias stays bearish but only on a break back below 321.02, with a reclaim of 324.57 invalidating the short and a sustained hold above 338.03 revising the bias. Versus the previous read, price has pushed through the FVG top instead of being capped by it and the pivot structure has stepped down, so the short is now later and lower rather than confirmed.

Price has slid further to 735.60, breaking through the 736.70–737.87 bull gap flagged as the invalidation line in the prior read, so that condition is now triggered and the near-term bullish structure is compromised. The 4H remains bullish and the combined stance is HOLD, but the 1H trend is down and price sits just above the last open bull gap at 732.48–732.92, which is now the sole remaining support before the 725.62 lower pivot. Upside is capped by a stack of bear FVGs at 740.03–740.64, 743.66–745.00 and 745.28–747.00, keeping the 751.86 trigger far out of reach. Bias is neutral-to-weak: a clean hold of 732.48 keeps the layered-support thesis alive for a reclaim attempt, but a loss of 732.48 invalidates the setup and exposes 725.62.

BRK.B holds the BUY bias with price at 574.23, still in clear air above the upper pivot, which has shifted up to 549.96 from 543.34 — a higher support shelf that confirms the prior read's bullish structure rather than revising it. The 1H trend remains up but the last bar is again flat (+0.12%), so momentum confirmation is still thin and the setup stays extended, keeping this a watch rather than a chase. Open FVGs remain empty, so there are no unfilled support shelves beneath price; the entry at 549.96 with stop 548.11 defines the invalidation, and a break below that stop would flip the structure and void the bullish case. Upside target is now 603.96, above the prior 590.72, with the regime still NEUTRAL.

The bearish bias is confirmed and the setup has activated: price at 80,666.01 has broken below the 80,939.54 entry, which now flips from trigger to overhead resistance and sits just above the 80,666 level as the key reclaim line. The last 1H bar bounced (+0.44%, 80,832.13→81,189.43) into the 81,200–81,330 bear FVG, so the short is live but the entry is no longer fresh — the bounce is testing the stop at 81,186.00, which is the immediate invalidation for the active trade. Compared to the prior read, the direction of travel resolved in favor of the short as expected, but the entry was reached and slightly overshot rather than cleanly tagged; the 4H remains bearish while the combined regime reads HOLD, so the bias stays bearish toward 76,981.08 but the stop at 81,186.00 is now the line that matters, with a reclaim of 81,330 (top of the FVG) and then 82,647 the broader repair levels.

Price has recovered to 2,370.71 and is now testing the 2,370.49 stop from just below, with the 1H printing a higher close (2,367.27→2,387.60) for the first time in this sequence — the immediate downside momentum that justified the short has stalled. The bias stays bearish on the 4H, but the combined signal has shifted from SELL to HOLD, so conviction is weaker than the prior read: the short is now one tick from invalidation rather than waiting cleanly on the 2,360.32 trigger. The fresh bear FVG has moved up to 2,388.29–2,396.88, which now caps any further bounce and is the level to watch for a rejection back into the trade. A reclaim of 2,526.62 still invalidates the bearish structure, but a stop-out at 2,370.49 effectively ends this setup; only a break back below 2,360.32 re-arms the short toward 2,194.02.

Bias stays SELL and the structure is intact: price at 321.21 sits just below the 322.00 entry pivot with the 1H trend down, so the trade remains WATCHING, not triggered. The change since the prior read is that the entry has been pulled down from 330.38 to 322.00 with the stop tightened to 324.54 and the target extended to 284.60, while the 322.64–322.74 bearish FVG still caps the market overhead and the 326.49–327.01 gap remains the next resistance layer. The last 1H bar eased 322.00→321.21, confirming sellers still control the near term. The plan now holds as entry 322.00, stop 324.54, target 284.60, with invalidation a reclaim above 324.54 that would clear the immediate supply and break the bearish stack.

LLY remains a BUY, with the bias bullish above the 1,321.21 upper pivot after price held at 1,330.26 and the 1H trend stayed up. Versus the prior read, the pivot shifted up from 1,311.75 to 1,321.21 and the target rose from 1,492.29 to 1,511.21, so the setup is confirmed but the entry, stop (1,309.40) and target have all ratcheted higher. With no open FVGs, there is no overhead gap resistance, though the NEUTRAL regime still favors confirmation over chasing. Invalidation is a decisive break back below 1,321.21, which reverts to a hold and exposes the 1,131.21 lower pivot.

META's SELL bias holds and the setup is now armed: the entry trigger has moved down to 639.69, just 5.91 below current price at 645.60, versus the previous 681.05 trigger that price never approached. The 1H trend remains down and the combined 1D+1H signal still reads HOLD, so conviction stays modest under the NEUTRAL regime, but the bearish FVG at 648.42–650.38 still caps upside as immediate resistance. Stop is 647.38 and target 508.11, with the lower pivot at 639.69 as the level to break for activation. Invalidation is a reclaim above 647.38, which would push price back through the bearish FVG and undercut the short.

MSFT remains in the same holding pattern: price at 542.22 still sits below the 551.15 upper pivot, the 1H trend is up, and the combined signal stays HOLD, so the cautiously bullish bias is confirmed rather than revised. The setup is unchanged in structure but tighter in parameters — entry on a break above 551.15, stop now 547.75 (just under the prior 547.83 level), and target trimmed to 605.05 from 611.08, with no open FVGs left to act as support. The trigger is still the 551.15 break; until then the bias is watch-only. Invalidation is a drop below 547.75, which would flip the 1H trend and revive the bearish case toward the 497.25 lower pivot.

Bias stays bearish but the short has slipped from live to watching: price at 211.76 is now pinning just above the 211.26 lower pivot rather than extending through it, so the break is no longer confirmed and the setup has reset to a fresh trigger at 211.26. The 1D direction and combined regime both remain SELL, with the 1H trend down, and the stacked bearish FVGs at 214.17–215.09 and 215.20–220.26 still cap upside; the 243.37 upper pivot stays irrelevant. Levels have shifted from the prior read — entry 211.26 (was 212.77), stop 213.10 (was 214.54), target 179.15 (was 182.17) — so the trade is tighter and deeper, not invalidated. Invalidation is a close back above 213.10 into the lowest FVG, which would also reclaim the pivot and flip the watching stance back to neutral.

The bear case has progressed: price broke below the 103.04 trigger and is now at 102.07, with a fresh bear FVG at 102.98–103.53 forming directly overhead as new supply, reinforcing the original 104.20–104.36 gap. Bias stays SELL, but the combined 4H+1H read has softened to HOLD and regime is NEUTRAL, so this is a watching stance rather than a fresh entry — the original setup (entry 103.04, stop 103.52, target 96.88) is now extended, and chasing here sits under two stacked bear gaps. The 1H's last candle bounced (102.33→102.85), so watch whether price rejects at the 102.98–103.53 gap to confirm continuation toward 96.88. Invalidation is unchanged: a push through 109.20 flips this back to neutral, while a reclaim above 103.53 would weaken the immediate bear structure.

TSLA's bias remains neutral-watch, unchanged: price at 372.98, the 1H trend still down, and the combined 1D+1H signal at HOLD with 1D bullish. The only shift is the trigger level, now 388.86 (stop 385.25, target 431.84) versus the prior 388.84/385.12/431.81 — a negligible recalibration, not a structural change. The last 1H leg is again stabilized at 371.95→372.36 (+0.11%), still too weak to flip the 1H downtrend, and the FVG field stays empty so no overhead drag. Stand aside until a close above 388.86 confirms; a break of 345.88 remains the invalidation that flips the broader structure bearish.

The SELL setup remains expired and the bearish bias is unchanged: price extended the rollover to 53.90, further below the 54.38 pivot, with 1H trend down and the combined read still SELL under a BEARISH regime. The only shift is on the supply side — the 55.53–55.73 bear FVG has dropped out of the open list, leaving a single stacked FVG at 54.98–55.10 overhead, so the resistance shelf has thinned slightly but still sits well above price. The 54.38 pivot now acts as resistance with the 50.14 target live while price holds beneath it. Invalidation is unchanged at a sustained reclaim of 54.61, which would flip the short-term read neutral-to-bullish.

Price has slipped to 3,995.81 and the lower pivot has shifted down to 3,975.65, so the setup is now a pending sell at that level rather than the prior 3,986.73 entry — the bearish bias is confirmed and extended, not revised. The 4H direction is explicitly bearish and the combined 4H+1H read is SELL, with the 1H still grinding lower (-0.10% on the last bar) and the 4,048.55–4,048.76 bear FVG untouched as overhead supply. Bias stays bearish with entry 3,975.65, stop 3,985.47, and target 3,795.73; the deeper target reflects the lower pivot structure. Invalidation: a sustained reclaim above the 4,048.55–4,048.76 FVG voids the setup, while a clean break of 3,975.65 opens the path toward 3,795.73.

Price has broken below the 1.29 trigger to 1.28, so the bearish bias is confirmed and the setup has progressed from watching to triggered. The key shift is the new bear FVG at 1.2965–1.3041, which now caps the 1.30 pivot as overhead supply and aligns with the entry/stop at 1.30; target sits at 1.19 with the 1.40 cap still the invalidation. The combined 4H+1H signal has softened from SELL to HOLD even as 4H stays bearish and 1H trends down, so momentum is stalling near the lows rather than accelerating. Bias stays bearish: a hold below 1.30 keeps 1.19 in play, while a reclaim of 1.40 flips the read.
